title: Speed Force vs Artificial Speed: Flash vs Reverse Flash
script: This is The Speed Force. This is The Negative Speed Force. So what's the difference? Most fans think Barry Allen and Eobard Thawne pull speed from the same place. They don't. The Speed Force is a positive kinetic energy field created by Barry's movement that generates momentum and protects the timeline. But The Negative Speed Force was created by Thawne using hatred, eating away at kinetic energy and corrupting time. Barry creates speed with movement, while Thawne feeds speed with hatred. Follow for more.
